title: Vickers Wellington LN660 and Short Stirling EH989
memorial_details:
description: Plinth: IN MEMORY OF / WESTCOTT AIRFIELD / OPENED 09.1942 / CLOSED 03.04.1946 / DEDICATED TO ALL UNITS / AND PERSONEL BASED HERE / AIRFIELDS / OF BRITAIN / Conservation Trust / www.abct.org.uk / UNVEILED BY / KENNETH P. BANNERMAN / DIRECTOR GENERAL ABCT / 28.09.2012 / 70TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE INITIAL ARRIVAL / OF NO. 11 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT //  
Plaque: IN MEMORIAM / These young airmen lost their lives on 15th March 1944 / in a mid-air collision. / 
Left column: Wellington X LN 660 KJ-O, / No 11 O T U Westcott / (8 Names) // 
Right column: Stirling III EH 989 WP-P, / No 90 Squadron / Tuddenham / (7 Names)
